comparisons.name: browser-toolbar-light
comparisons.description: The toolbar of the browser in the expanded Save panel, Aqua, against the toolbar of TextEdit's Open panel at the same width: the two panels share the browser, and no screenshot shows a Save panel. The first row and the corners of the capture are the Open panel's window frame and are masked. Glyphs are stand-ins and text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: browser-toolbar-light-drawing
comparisons.description: The toolbar of the browser in the expanded Save panel, Aqua, against the toolbar of TextEdit's Open panel at the same width: the two panels share the browser, and no screenshot shows a Save panel. The first row and the corners of the capture are the Open panel's window frame and are masked. The glyphs (stand-ins for Apple's artwork) and all text (fallback font off Apple platforms) are masked too: the bar, the bezels and the line alone.

comparisons.name: collapsed-light
comparisons.description: The collapsed form, Aqua: name field, Tags field and Where pop-up button in one column, 8 pt apart, and Cancel and the default button at the trailing end, 20 pt under the last row. No screenshot shows a Save panel: the layout is inferred, and the colours are those of the controls it is made of.
